answer: A one-time entry tax stops fake identities. Each new identity pays a non-refundable 40-credit tax to transact, a trellis honest climbers commit to. Honest agents earn it back: every 10 clean epochs refunds 4 credits, so 40 returns within 100 epochs. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 x 40 = 40,000 credits. One ember of proven fraud forfeits refund and identity. Honest agents pay once and keep full reward, while fakes sink in a lagoon of spent tax.
